name: room_co2_ventilation
description: Single-zone room CO2 demand-controlled ventilation (FR-10 golden, written by hand from the L2 bundle).

sources.title: RM-201 Indoor Air Quality Control - Owner Requirements
RM-201 CO2 Ventilation Control - Control Sequence and Modeling Notes
DR-IAQ-05 - Indoor Air Quality Control Design Review
RM-201 CO2 loop - BMS and controls email thread

attributes.mixing: single perfectly mixed zone; no local stratification

trace.quote: Tag: ZON-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: volume | Type: Well-mixed room volume
URS-IAQ-001 - The room shall be represented as a single well-mixed air volume of 100 m3.
component "RoomVolume\nV=100 m3" as Room

attributes.sign_convention: modelling device: the command is the mass flow at the source port, negative for air entering the room; the physical supply flow is positive

trace.quote: Tag: SRC-OA-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: freshAir | Type: Controlled mass-flow source
The simulation source component shall use negative mass-flow sign for air entering the room because of the source-port sign convention.
In the Modelica source component, inflow is represented with a **negative mass-flow command**.
Tag: BND-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: boundary4 | Type: Pressure boundary
Room air leaves through an exhaust duct to an ideal pressure boundary.

attributes.carrier_concentration: modelling device: C = 100 kg/kg with the carrier flow scaled by 1/100, so the CO2 injected is 8.18E-6 kg/s per person; not a physical composition

trace.quote: Tag: SRC-CO2-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: peopleSource | Type: Trace-substance mass source
The 100 kg/kg value is a numerical device only and must not be interpreted as a physical room concentration.
`C_source=100 kg/kg` is a numerical implementation parameter and shall not be shown as a realistic room or outdoor gas composition.
Tag: SCH-OCC-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: NumberOfPeople | Type: Occupancy schedule
The number-of-people signal shall be piecewise constant between defined schedule change times.

attributes.signal: trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg; the physical device reports ppm

trace.quote: Tag: SEN-CO2-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: traceVolume | Type: CO2 trace sensor
The room sensor output is a trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg.

attributes.normalisation: output is dimensionless: 1.0 is C_nominal = 1.519E-3 kg/kg, the project's 1000 ppm

trace.quote: Tag: GAIN-NORM-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: gainSensor | Type: Gain
gainSensor multiplies it by 1/C_nominal so that 1000 ppm becomes the normalized value 1.0.
Tag: SET-CO2-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: CO2Set | Type: Constant setpoint
This is a normalized controller signal, not 1 ppm and not 1 kg/kg.

attributes.integral: disabled in the released reference run
attributes.sensor_fault_fallback: 4 ACH after the sensor is invalid for 60 s; outside the baseline run, not modelled

trace.quote: Tag: CTL-CO2-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: PID | Type: PID/P controller
Integral action shall be disabled in the released hackathon reference run to avoid negative windup during long unoccupied periods.
Tag: GAIN-AIR-201 | Alias / Legacy Name: gain1 | Type: Gain
Apply a negative sign to the Modelica source command because negative source m_flow denotes flow from the source into the connected duct.

CR-IAQ-007 set the bias to 3.5 ACH; the archived model's 3.0 is marked stale.
DR-IAQ-05 keeps outdoor CO2 at 300 ppm; the archived model's 350 ppm is stale.
